summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of cybersecurity incident response platform. All core features working correctly including landing page with 6 incident types, AI chatbot powered by Gemini 3 Flash, recovery links with verified badges, and prevention tips page.
passed_tests: All 6 incident types display correctly on landing page (Instagram, Gmail, Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, Microsoft)
Incident cards are clickable and navigate to correct incident response pages
Prevention tips button navigates to prevention page with 4 security tips
Split-screen layout loads correctly on incident response pages
AI chatbot initializes with platform-specific greeting messages
Chat functionality works - users can send messages and receive AI responses
Recovery links display with verified badges for each platform
Scam warning messages are prominently displayed
Back navigation buttons work correctly across all pages
All data-testid attributes are present for automated testing
All API endpoints return correct status codes and data
Chat sessions create successfully and maintain state
Error handling works for invalid platforms and sessions
Gemini 3 Flash integration provides contextual, platform-specific responses
